history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED (with an honest limitation): the original 'no mosques found' branch is still unreachable in preview (expo-location's real permission check blocks before a mocked fetch would matter). But reaching the 'denied' branch surfaced a real bug: Linking.openSettings() has no react-native-web implementation, throws synchronously at 4 call sites. Added .catch() to all 4 (correct for native's rare promise-rejection case) but documented clearly that .catch() cannot catch a synchronous throw - the web-preview crash itself is an iteration-21-class harmless shim gap, zero impact on real native.
